description: Source code for managing EGL layer discovery, initialization, and function hooking in Android's graphics stack, including dynamic loading of layer libraries, setup of function pointers, and chain application for EGL and GLES functions.

classes.name: FunctionTable
classes.description: Structure holding an array of EGL function pointers with an operator overload for access.

classes.name: LayerLoader
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for loading, initializing, and applying EGL/GLES layering functions, managing function chains, and dynamic library loading.

methods.name: LayerLoader::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LayerLoader, loading layers if not already loaded.

methods.name: LayerLoader::LoadLayers
methods.description: Loads layer libraries based on debug layer list and system properties, dynamically loads libraries, and retrieves initialization and setup functions.

methods.name: LayerLoader::InitLayers
methods.description: Initializes layer function chains for a given EGL connection, setting up function pointers and applying layer chains.

methods.name: LayerLoader::ApplyLayers
methods.description: Applies configured layers to a function call chain for a given function name and next function pointer.

methods.name: LayerLoader::LayerPlatformEntries
methods.description: Replaces platform API function pointers with layered versions.

methods.name: LayerLoader::LayerDriverEntries
methods.description: Replaces driver API function pointers with layered versions, skipping those handled by platform.

methods.name: LayerLoader::GetDebugLayers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of debug layers from GraphicsEnv or system properties.

methods.name: LayerLoader::Initialized
methods.description: Checks if layers have been initialized.
